name: Pomodoro
description: A focus session like Windows Focus: pick the total minutes, optionally split into 22-33 min focus blocks with 5 min breaks, then follow the ring. Pause, skip, add 5 minutes, a toast at each phase change and a daily tally of focus minutes. Optional webcam timelapse of the whole session (replaces Study Time-Lapse). Survives restarts.
author: AmineChr54
changelog: Listed under a category on Browse and the website.

autoStart.label: Start the next phase automatically
autoStart.hint: Off: the session waits for you at each break and focus period.

notify.label: Notify at each phase change
notify.hint: Also set Notifications to On (or Default with notifications allowed in General) for this widget in Settings.
